item.title: Trump halts Iran strike, citing negotiation progress
item.description: President Trump announced on Saturday that he has canceled a planned attack on Iran, citing advancements in talks between the two countries.

item.title: Saudi crown prince voices concerns to Trump over planned Iran strikes
item.description: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with President Trump on Saturday, expressing concern about his plans for large-scale strikes against Iran.

item.title: DeepSeek's low-cost model intensifies AI's race to zero pricing
item.description: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released a new coding model on Friday that charges minimal fees for extensive usage, accelerating the trend toward cheaper AI.

item.title: Tillis predicts Blanche's AG nomination will fail amid Trump fund dispute
item.description: Senator Thom Tillis stated on Saturday that recent comments by President Trump about his 'anti-weaponization' fund make it unlikely that attorney general nominee Todd Blanche will be confirmed.
